weather_report:
Today in Boston, as the sun stretches into the late morning, the air carries a subtle warmth, hinting at the high of 81 that lies ahead. The sky asserts itself with a mix of sun and clouds, creating a dynamic backdrop that speaks of possibilities. As the day wears on, there lingers a gentle anticipation of showers and thunderstorms, expected to arrive after 11 o'clock. It may be wise to venture forth with a light jacket or an umbrella, should the clouds decide to shift their demeanor.

Looking into the evening, a continuation of this cloud-laden patina will envelop the city while temperatures take a tender dip to around 65. It is a night for languid strolls through local parks or perhaps a visit to a tucked-away café, where one can watch the world drift by amid the occasional rumble of thunder. The air will be alive, a testament to a day that balances warmth with the thrill of impending rain, painting a soft yet vibrant picture of Boston.
